name: ten-billion-lives
description: A compact, deterministic local observatory for ten billion represented lives.

scripts.benchmark: pnpm build && node scripts/run-benchmarks.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results && pnpm benchmark:check
scripts.benchmark:fields: pnpm --filter @ten-billion-lives/sim build && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-fields.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results/field-simulation.json
scripts.benchmark:transport: pnpm --filter @ten-billion-lives/sim build && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-transport.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results/planetary-day.json
scripts.benchmark:kernel: pnpm --filter @ten-billion-lives/sim build && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-kernel.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results/world-kernel.json
scripts.benchmark:experience: pnpm build && node scripts/benchmark-experience.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results/person-experience.json
scripts.benchmark:adaptive: pnpm build && node scripts/benchmark-adaptive-quality.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results/adaptive-quality.json docs/evidence/issue-22/soak-trace.json
scripts.benchmark:soak: pnpm build && node scripts/benchmark-adaptive-quality.mjs --wall-clock && prettier --write benchmarks/results/adaptive-quality.json docs/evidence/issue-22/soak-trace.json
scripts.benchmark:world: pnpm --filter @ten-billion-lives/sim build && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-world.mjs && prettier --write benchmarks/results/world-generation.json
scripts.test:contracts: node scripts/check-product-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-living-city-contract.mjs
scripts.docs:check: cspell --no-progress --show-suggestions README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/*.md && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.evidence:compatibility: pnpm build && node scripts/capture-compatibility.mjs && prettier --write docs/evidence/issue-23/*.json docs/evidence/issue-23/*.yml
scripts.qa:replay: pnpm build && node scripts/capture-m2-replay.mjs docs/evidence/issue-25 && prettier --write docs/evidence/issue-25/deterministic-replay.json
scripts.qa:visual: pnpm build && node scripts/capture-observatory.mjs docs/evidence/issue-25 && prettier --write docs/evidence/issue-25/*.json
